used with the owner's permission and under the licences they publish:

Credit, as each original suggests: “Mallee HydroTech, *&lt;title&gt;*, CC BY 4.0;
modified for Flood-Net.”

## What was changed

No file from the originals — code, image, model or audio — is copied into
Flood-Net. Each tab is a rewrite in Flood-Net's own plain JavaScript and SVG
that teaches the same content: the lessons condensed, the practice drills and
scenarios re-implemented (the arithmetic of the originals' practice models —
staff tilt, heat haze, tolerances, scoring — ported under the MIT licence), and
the drawings redrawn. The originals' apps (React, Next.js,
three.js), 3D scenes, photographs, audio, progress tracking, certificates and
score services were left out. Each tab names its own changes in its **Source and
credit** panel (`knowledge-base.js`).

Any mistake in Flood-Net's versions is Flood-Net's, not Mallee HydroTech's.
Mallee HydroTech does not endorse Flood-Net, and its grant gives no trademark
rights. Third-party material in the originals (CC0 textures, models and
recordings; Lucide/Feather icons) was not used.
